searchText: does anyone know any good documentation on Geth's architecture? I gave this talk at some point to explain a bit of the architecture, not great though: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c4N79UXZqSc&t=1089s&pp=ygUVbWFyaXVzIHZhbiBkZXIgd2lqZGVu hey, have anyone tried running consensus-spec tests against lighthouse (or any other CL)? is it even possible? 🤔 I guess for running it for specific clients you need to use testing tools like Hive, etc ``` ./hive --sim ethereum/consensus --client lighthouse ``` hmm. Thanks! I'll look into hive Hive is running integration tests. So, probably, it depends on what exactly you want to test Check this out as well: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/tree/stable/testing/ef_tests can someone refer some blogs and research papers on weak subjectivity? <@910947446077665330> https://notes.ethereum.org/@adiasg/weak-subjectvity-eth2 Here is a blog on weak subjectivity Already posted here I can see if you pull the lh repo you can run consensus spec tests against it locally using `make test-ef` <@706747269424218124> can you please check your dm ? Hey thanks🚀
